# 7Captur

> 7Captur is a weekly profit and ad decision desk for e-commerce brands spending $20K to $150K a month on Meta and Google Ads. Every Monday it reconciles Shopify, Meta and Google exports against product costs, shipping, payment fees and 30-day refunds, and a human analyst verifies a one-page decision memo: what to cut, hold or test. Access is read-only. Fees are flat, never a percentage of ad spend.

## Offer
- Free 60-Day Ad Leak Audit: a one-time look back at the past 60 days, delivered in 48 hours with a 20-minute walkthrough. It is not a trial.
- Core Desk: $2,500 a month, or $6,000 for a 3-month prepay
- Scale Desk: $3,500 a month, or $8,400 for a 3-month prepay
- 90-day initial commitment, then month-to-month. Bespoke scopes start at $5,000 a month.
- 7Captur does not edit ad accounts, and is not an ad agency, accounting service or CFO service.

- [About](https://7captur.com/about/): operating principles and founder
- [Resources](https://7captur.com/resources/): guides on ROAS, margin and budgets

## Guides
- [ROAS vs Profit: How to Calculate Break-Even ROAS](https://7captur.com/articles/roas-vs-profit-break-even-roas/): A good-looking ROAS can still lose money. Learn the break-even ROAS formula, why margin, returns and fees change the answer, and how to check whether your ads make a profit.
- [True ROAS Explained: What It Is and How to Calculate It](https://7captur.com/articles/true-roas-explained/): True ROAS is return on ad spend after costs, returns and fees. Learn the formula, see a worked example, and understand why it differs from the ROAS your ad platform reports.
- [Advertising Budget Optimization: A Practical Guide for E-commerce](https://7captur.com/articles/advertising-budget-optimization/): Advertising budget optimization means moving money to the campaigns that return the most margin. A five-step process for e-commerce brands running Meta and Google Ads.
- [Ad Spend Management: How to Set, Split and Review Your Budget](https://7captur.com/articles/ad-spend-management/): Ad spend management is how you decide how much to spend, where, and when to change it. A routine for e-commerce brands, with a monthly review checklist.
- [How to Allocate Your Advertising Budget Across Channels](https://7captur.com/articles/advertising-budget-allocation/): How to divide an e-commerce ad budget between Meta, Google and other channels, using cost per order against break-even, with an example split and review rules.
- [E-commerce Analytics: The Few Numbers Worth Tracking](https://7captur.com/articles/ecommerce-analytics-metrics-that-matter/): E-commerce analytics can drown you in dashboards. These are the handful of metrics a store should track, what each one means, and how often to check it.
- [Ad Performance Tracking: A Simple Checklist for Meta and Google Ads](https://7captur.com/articles/ad-performance-tracking/): How to track ad performance without drowning in reports. A short checklist for Meta (Facebook and Instagram) and Google Ads: what to export, what to record and what to compare.
